div.div: The permission filter belongs inside the retrieval query, scoped to the current user. "Only answer about documents they can see" is an instruction, not an access control.

div.div: Measure the halves separately: recall@k for retrieval (was the right chunk in the top k?), then groundedness and citation accuracy for generation.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 557px; margin-left: 40px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-warn-fg);

div.div: The frontend owes the user three things a demo skips: the sources, visible and clickable; citations that hydrate rather than jump as tokens stream; and a designed "I could not find this" state — because a refusal is a success, and without a place to put it the model invents instead.
